docs.title: 10.4.9.1. src/app/pages/connexion
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/login/connexion.ts - the login page (/login)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Same page as views/login.hbs in the HTML application: login, password
// password, CAPTCHA, and a second "Create a Customer Account" button that verifies
// the MÊME captcha before allowing the account creation process to proceed.
//
// /login?login=jbernard: the login field is pre-filled (immediately after
// account creation).
// /login?redirect=/medecins: after logging in, this page opens
// (provided by the router) rather than the role’s home page.
// These two parameters are passed to the component as ENTRÉES.
// =========================================================================

import { afterNextRender, Component, inject, input, signal, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField, required } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { EnvoiFormulaire } from '../../services/envoi-formulaire';
import { ChampCaptcha } from '../../components/champ-captcha';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-connexion',
  imports: [FormField, TranslatePipe, ChampCaptcha],
  templateUrl: './connexion.html',
})
export class ConnexionPage {
  readonly login = input<string>(); // ?login=...
  readonly redirect = input<string>(); // ?redirect=...

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly modele = signal({ login: '', password: '', captcha: '' });
   // Two rules: login and password are required. [formField] then sets
   // the "required" attribute on both fields, and the browser refuses
   // to submit the form as long as they are empty
  protected readonly f = form(this.modele, (p) => {
    required(p.login);
    required(p.password);
  });
  private readonly envoi = new EnvoiFormulaire(this.f);
   // the CAPTCHA component, to call its methods captchaId() and reload()
  private readonly champCaptcha = viewChild.required(ChampCaptcha);

  constructor() {
    afterNextRender(() => {
       // the inputs are now known: the URL login, if there is one
      const login = (this.login() ?? '').slice(0, 30);
      this.modele.update((m) => ({ ...m, login }));
       // Focus: on the password field if the username is already filled in
      (login ? this.f.password : this.f.login)().focusBoundControl();
    });
  }

   // Both buttons follow this sequence: submit, then, if that fails,
   // error message and NOUVELLE image (each is used only once)
  private async tenter(action: () => Promise<unknown>, ignorerValidateurs = false): Promise<void> {
    this.messages.effacer();
    await this.envoi.envoyer(async () => {
      try {
        await action();
      } catch (e) {
         // the new image AVANT ensures the error is not attached to the field:
         // reload() clears the field, which would remove the error
        await this.champCaptcha().recharger();
        throw e;
      }
    }, ignorerValidateurs);
  }

  protected async seConnecter(evenement: Event): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    const { login, password, captcha } = this.modele();
    await this.tenter(async () => {
      await this.session.connecter(login.trim(), password, this.champCaptcha().captchaId(), captcha);
      const redirect = this.redirect();
       // only one path INTERNE: never redirect to another site
      const interne = redirect !== undefined && redirect.startsWith('/') && !redirect.startsWith('//');
      await this.router.navigateByUrl(interne ? redirect : this.session.pageAccueil());
    });
  }

  protected async creerCompte(): Promise<void> {
    await this.tenter(async () => {
      await this.api.accesInscription(this.champCaptcha().captchaId(), this.modele().captcha);
      await this.router.navigate(['/inscription']);
    }, true); // Username and password are not used here: their rules are ignored
  }
}

The login page: username, password, CAPTCHA, and a second “Create a Customer Account” button that verifies the MÊME CAPTCHA before allowing account creation.

  • Lines 31–32: two URL parameters: /login?login=jbernard pre-fills the username (immediately after account creation); /login?redirect=/medecins, set by the on-call doctor, specifies the page to open after login;
  • Lines 43–46: The application’s only form with a schema: username and password are required. The [[formField]] directive then sets the HTML and [required] attributes on both fields, and the browser refuses to submit the form as long as they are empty;
  • line 47: submitting the form (services/envoi-formulaire.ts);
  • line 49: the captcha component, to call its methods;
  • lines 52–58: [afterNextRender]: once the page is displayed, the entries are known. The login from the URL is copied into the form (limited to 30 characters), and focus is set on the first empty field. [focusBoundControl()] sets the focus on the element linked to the field by [[formField]];
  • Lines 63–75: Both buttons follow this sequence: submit, then, if that fails, a new image (each is used only once). The order matters: [recharger] clears the CAPTCHA field, which would remove the error associated with that field; we therefore reload the image AVANT to trigger the error again, which [EnvoiFormulaire] will then associate with the field;
  • lines 77–87: login, followed by navigation to the requested page or to the role’s home page. As in Example 18, only an internal path is accepted (line 84);
  • lines 89–94: the second button. The server verifies the CAPTCHA and sets a “pass” (a cookie); the account creation page then opens. The username and password are not used here: the schema rules are ignored (line 93).
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-sm-8 col-md-6 col-lg-5">
    <div class="card p-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'LOGIN.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>

      <form (submit)="seConnecter($event)">
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="login">{{ 'LOGIN.LOGIN_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <input id="login" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" [formField]="f.login">
        </div>
        <div class="mb-3">
          <label class="form-label" for="password">{{ 'LOGIN.PASSWORD_LABEL' | translate }}</label>
          <input id="password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password"
                 [formField]="f.password">
        </div>

         <!-- a "custom" control, linked to the form's CAPTCHA field -->
        <app-champ-captcha [formField]="f.captcha" />

         <!-- type="submit": Entering text in a field triggers "Log In" -->
        <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary w-100" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'LOGIN.SUBMIT' | translate }}</button>

         <!-- type="button": This button does not submit the form (no
             contrôle required sur login et mot de passe, inutiles ici) -->
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-primary w-100 mt-3" [disabled]="f().submitting()" (click)="creerCompte()">
          {{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT' | translate }}
        </button>
        <div class="form-text text-center">{{ 'LOGIN.CREATE_ACCOUNT_HELP' | translate }}</div>
      </form>

      <div class="text-muted small mt-3">
        {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ACCOUNTS' | translate }}
        <ul class="mb-0 mt-1">
          <li><code>admin</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_ADMIN' | translate }}</li>
          <li><code>pelissier</code>, <code>tatou</code>, <code>dupont</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_DOCTOR' | translate }}</li>
          <li><code>martin</code>, <code>durand</code>, <code>bistrou</code>, <code>german</code> - {{ 'LOGIN.DEMO_USER' | translate }}</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
  • line 6: no [novalidate] here: the browser reports an empty username or password;
  • line 18: the custom CAPTCHA check, linked to the [captcha] field in the form;
  • line 21: the button is disabled during submission ([submitting()]);
  • line 25: [type="button"]: this button does not submit the form, so the browser does not require a username and password.

docs.title: 10.4.9.2. src/app/pages/agenda
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/agenda/agenda.ts - the calendar page (/agenda)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Three blocks, like views/agenda.hbs from the HTML application:
//    1. selection of the doctor and the day;
//    2. that doctor’s schedule for that day;
//    3. the appointment booking window.
//
// As in the HTML application, TOUT the page status is in its URL:
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-            05 the calendar
//      /agenda?idMedecin=1&day=2026-10-05&reserve= 7 + the reservation window
// You can therefore reload the page, bookmark it, or use the
// Back / Forward buttons in the browser. The page SUIT becomes URL: the three
// parameters are sent as ENTRÉES (signals), and a reload occurs
// refreshes the calendar when the doctor or the day changes; the user’s actions
// change the URL (router.navigate).
//
// What each user sees and can do is determined by the SERVEUR (fields
// patient, me, bookable, idRv for each time slot): the page simply
// display it. A patient does not even see the names of the other patients.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, effect, inject, input, signal, untracked } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ErreurApi } from '../../api/erreur-api';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Agenda, CreneauAgenda, Personne } from '../../api/types';
import { aujourdhui, estUneDateValide, horaire } from '../../pipes/formatage';
import { HorairePipe, JourLongPipe, LibellePipe } from '../../pipes/formatage.pipes';
import { LangueService } from '../../i18n/langue.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { FenetreReservation } from '../../components/fenetre-reservation/fenetre-reservation';

// "3" -> 3; "", "abc", "-2", absent -> null
function entierPositif(valeur: string | undefined): number | null {
  const n = Number(valeur);
  return valeur !== undefined && valeur !== '' && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0 ? n : null;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-agenda',
  imports: [FormsModule, RouterLink, TranslatePipe, HorairePipe, JourLongPipe, LibellePipe, FenetreReservation],
  templateUrl: './agenda.html',
})
export class AgendaPage {
   // the parameters of the URL (undefined if absent)
  readonly idMedecin = input<string>();
  readonly jour = input<string>();
  readonly reserver = input<string>();

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  protected readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly langue = inject(LangueService).langue;

  protected readonly medecins = signal<Personne[]>([]);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Personne[]>([]); // ADMIN / DOCTOR: for the appointment window
  protected readonly agenda = signal<Agenda | null>(null);
  protected readonly chargement = signal(false);
  protected readonly envoiEnCours = signal(false);

   // the values from the "doctor + day" form, copied from URL
  protected readonly choixMedecin = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly choixJour = signal(aujourdhui());

   // the displayed calendar, without the booking window: the "return" query
  protected readonly queryAgenda = computed(() => ({ idMedecin: String(this.choixMedecin() ?? ''), jour: this.choixJour() }));

   // the time slot for which the booking window is open (?reserver=7),
   // only if it is bookable by this user
  protected readonly creneauAReserver = computed<CreneauAgenda | null>(() => {
    const id = entierPositif(this.reserver());
    return this.agenda()?.creneaux.find((c) => c.id === id && c.reservable) ?? null;
  });

   // the name of the logged-in patient (USER), or null for ADMIN and DOCTOR
  protected readonly patient = computed(() => (this.session.estPatient() ? (this.session.utilisateur()?.nom ?? '') : null));

  constructor() {
    this.chargerListes();
     // the calendar follows URL (doctor and day): LIT combines the two entries,
     // and the upload is untracked
    effect(() => {
      const idMedecin = this.idMedecin();
      const jour = this.jour();
      untracked(() => this.chargerAgenda(idMedecin, jour));
    });
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   // uploads
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  private async chargerListes(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.medecins.set(await this.api.lister('medecins'));
       // the patient list: only for those authorized to view it
      if (this.session.estGestionnaire()) {
        this.clients.set(await this.api.lister('clients'));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
  }

  private async chargerAgenda(idMedecinUrl: string | undefined, jourUrl: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
     // the date: the date from URL if valid, otherwise today
    this.choixJour.set(aujourdhui());
    if (jourUrl !== undefined) {
      if (!estUneDateValide(jourUrl)) {
        this.agenda.set(null);
        this.messages.afficherErreur('ERRORS.INVALID_DATE');
        return;
      }
      this.choixJour.set(jourUrl);
    }
     // the doctor: the one from the URL; if no doctor is specified, a DOCTOR sees the SON schedule
     // (the server retrieves it from the token)
    const idMedecin = entierPositif(idMedecinUrl);
    this.choixMedecin.set(idMedecin);
    if (idMedecin === null && this.session.role() !== 'DOCTOR') {
      this.agenda.set(null);
      return;
    }
    this.chargement.set(true);
    try {
      const agenda = await this.api.agenda(idMedecin, this.choixJour());
      this.agenda.set(agenda);
      this.choixMedecin.set(agenda.medecin.id);
    } catch (e) {
      this.agenda.set(null);
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    } finally {
      this.chargement.set(false);
    }
  }

   // the current URL’s calendar, updated (after a reservation or cancellation)
  private recharger(): Promise<void> {
    return this.chargerAgenda(this.idMedecin(), this.jour());
  }

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   // actions
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

   // "View Schedule": the URL is changed; the schedule updates accordingly (effect as described above)
  protected voirAgenda(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/agenda'], { queryParams: this.queryAgenda() });
  }

  protected fermerReservation(): void {
    this.router.navigate(['/agenda'], { queryParams: this.queryAgenda() });
  }

  protected async confirmerReservation(idClient: number | null): Promise<void> {
    const creneau = this.creneauAReserver();
    if (creneau === null) {
      return;
    }
    this.envoiEnCours.set(true);
    try {
      await this.api.reserver(this.choixJour(), creneau.id, this.session.estGestionnaire() ? idClient : null);
      this.messages.flash('succes', 'AGENDA.BOOKED');
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof ErreurApi && e.cle === 'ERRORS.CHOOSE_PATIENT') {
         // no patient selected: the window remains open
        this.messages.afficherErreur(e.cle);
        return; // (finally executes anyway)
      }
      if (!(e instanceof ErreurApi)) {
        throw e;
      }
       // slot taken in the meantime, patient already has an appointment...:
       // the message will appear on the calendar; window closed
      this.messages.flash('erreur', e.cle, e.params);
    } finally {
      this.envoiEnCours.set(false);
    }
    await this.router.navigate(['/agenda'], { queryParams: this.queryAgenda() });
    await this.recharger(); // the server’s record takes precedence: the calendar is re-read
  }

  protected async annuler(c: CreneauAgenda): Promise<void> {
    if (c.idRv === null || !(await this.confirmation.confirmer('AGENDA.CANCEL_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await this.api.annulerRv(c.idRv);
      this.messages.afficherSucces('AGENDA.CANCELLED');
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    await this.recharger();
  }

  protected horaire(c: CreneauAgenda): string {
    return horaire(c);
  }
}

The most feature-rich page in the application. As in the application HTML, TOUT, the page’s state is included in its URL: /agenda?idMedecin=1&jour=2026-10-05 displays a calendar, &reserver=7 adds the reservation window. You can therefore reload the page, bookmark it, and use the Back/Next buttons. The principle: the page follows its URL, and the user’s actions change the URL.

  • lines 51–53: the three URL parameters, as input;
  • lines 39–42: an address parameter can contain anything; it is validated;
  • lines 69–70: the values from the “doctor + day” form, copied from the URL;
  • line 73: the parameters for the displayed calendar, without a booking window;
  • lines 77–80: the time slot for which the booking window is open, calculated from the address ([?reserver=7]) and the calendar: only if it is bookable by this user. A [computed]: when the address changes, the window opens or closes automatically;
  • lines 89–93: an effect that depends on the two inputs [idMedecin] and [jour]: the calendar is reloaded when either of them changes. The reload is performed in [untracked]: the signals it reads and modifies do not become dependencies of the effect. The input [reserver] is not read: opening or closing the window does not reload the calendar;
  • lines 99–109: doctors, and patients for those who have permission to view them;
  • lines 111–141: loading the calendar. An invalid date is reported (lines 115–118); without a doctor, a DOCTOR sees the SON calendar: the server retrieves it from the token (lines 126–129);
  • lines 153–159: “View Calendar” and closing the window change the address; the calendar follows;
  • lines 161–187: the appointment booking. If successful, a pop-up message (line 169) appears; it will be displayed after line 185, which closes the window. If no patient has been selected, the window remains open (lines 171–175). Any other error (slot taken in the meantime, etc.) will be displayed on the calendar, with the window closed. In all cases, the calendar is re-read: the server’s record is final (line 186);
  • lines 189–200: cancellation, after confirmation.

@if (chargement() && !a) {

} @else if (a) {
  <div class="card p-3">

import { TypePersonnes } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';

}

export const CLES_PERSONNES: Record<TypePersonnes, ClesPersonnes> = {

    ajoute: 'CLIENTS.ADDED',
    modifie: 'CLIENTS.UPDATED',

};

// {name} and {login} "added / edited / deleted" messages

}

// pages/people/personnes.ts - the list of doctors OU for clients (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A single page for both: the type ("doctors" or "clients") is in
// the route data (data.type, see app.routes.ts) and is stored in
// ENTRÉE of the component; the labels specific to each are in
// personnes.config.ts. Equivalent to views/personnes/liste.hbs in
// the HTML application.
// "export default": the route loads the page on demand (loadComponent).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi, TypePersonnes } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { Personne } from '../../api/types';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from './personnes.config';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-personnes',
  imports: [RouterLink, TranslatePipe],
  templateUrl: './personnes.html',
})
export default class PersonnesPage implements OnInit {
  readonly type = input.required<TypePersonnes>(); // data.type from the route

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);

  protected readonly cles = computed(() => CLES_PERSONNES[this.type()]);
  protected readonly personnes = signal<Personne[] | null>(null); // null: not yet loaded

   // ngOnInit rather than the constructor: the inputs (type) are then known
  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.charger();
  }

  private async charger(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.personnes.set(await this.api.lister(this.type()));
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
  }

  protected async supprimer(p: Personne): Promise<void> {
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirmer(this.cles().confirmerSuppression))) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await this.api.supprimer(this.type(), p.id);
      this.messages.afficherSucces(this.cles().supprime, parametres(p));
    } catch (e) {
       // a doctor who still has appointments: 409 ERRORS.DOCTOR_HAS_APPOINTMENTS
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
    await this.charger();
  }
}

docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// pages/person-form/personne-formulaire.ts - creation OU modification
// of a doctor or a client (ADMIN)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//      /doctors/add           -> creation (no ID entry)
//      /doctors/3/edit        -> edit (ID = 3)
// (and the same URLs under /clients). Equivalent to
// views/people/formulaire.hbs in the HTML application.
//
// No rules are checked here: the server validates everything, and its errors
// are displayed below the fields (see services/envoi-formulaire.ts).
// The VERSION file read from the record is sent back with the modification: if another
// ADMIN has modified it in the meantime, the server responds with a 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, input, numberAttribute, OnInit, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ErreurApi } from '../../api/erreur-api';
import { RdvMedecinsApi, TypePersonnes } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { DonneesPersonne } from '../../api/types';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { EnvoiFormulaire } from '../../services/envoi-formulaire';
import { ChampsPersonne } from '../../components/champs-personne';
import { ChampSaisie } from '../../components/champ-saisie';
import { CLES_PERSONNES, parametres } from '../personnes/personnes.config';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-personne-formulaire',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, ChampsPersonne, ChampSaisie],
  templateUrl: './personne-formulaire.html',
})
export default class PersonneFormulairePage implements OnInit {
  readonly type = input.required<TypePersonnes>(); // data.type of the route
   // the :id parameter of the address, converted to a number; missing for a new creation
  readonly id = input(undefined, { transform: (v: string | undefined) => (v === undefined ? undefined : numberAttribute(v)) });

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly cles = computed(() => CLES_PERSONNES[this.type()]);
  protected readonly creation = computed(() => this.id() === undefined);

  protected readonly modele = signal<DonneesPersonne>({ titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', version: undefined });
  protected readonly f = form(this.modele); // no validator: the server validates
  protected readonly envoi = new EnvoiFormulaire(this.f);

   // modification: the record is read (including its version)
  async ngOnInit(): Promise<void> {
    const id = this.id();
    if (id === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const p = await this.api.lire(this.type(), id);
      this.modele.set({ titre: p.titre, prenom: p.prenom, nom: p.nom, login: p.login ?? '', password: '', version: p.version });
    } catch (e) {
       // record does not exist (deleted in the meantime...): return to the list
      if (!(e instanceof ErreurApi)) {
        throw e;
      }
      this.messages.flash('erreur', e.cle, e.params);
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    }
  }

  protected async enregistrer(evenement: Event): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    const id = this.id();
    const reussi = await this.envoi.envoyer(async () => {
      const donnees = this.modele();
      const p = id === undefined ? await this.api.ajouter(this.type(), donnees) : await this.api.modifier(this.type(), id, donnees);
      this.messages.flash('succes', this.creation() ? this.cles().ajoute : this.cles().modifie, parametres(p));
    });
    const cle = this.messages.erreur()?.cle;
    if (reussi) {
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    } else if (cle === 'ERRORS.DOCTOR_NOT_FOUND' || cle === 'ERRORS.PATIENT_NOT_FOUND') {
       // deleted in the meantime by another ADMIN: return to the list
      this.messages.flash('erreur', cle);
      this.router.navigate(['/', this.type()]);
    }
  }
}

Creation (/doctors/add) OU and modification (/doctors/3/edit) of a doctor or a client:

  • line 37: the address parameter [:id], which is absent for a creation. The option [transform] converts it to a number ([numberAttribute]);
  • line 44: creation or modification?
  • lines 46–48: the form, without a validator (the server validates everything), and its submission;
  • lines 51–67: for an update, the record is read, including its version; it will be updated with the changes (optimistic locking). A nonexistent record (/medecins/999/modifier) redirects to the list with a message;

If a record has been deleted in the meantime by another administrator, the user is also redirected to the list (lines 80–84); any other error leaves the form displayed, along with its errors.

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';

import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { EnvoiFormulaire } from '../../services/envoi-formulaire';
import { ChampsPersonne } from '../../components/champs-personne';
import { ChampSaisie } from '../../components/champ-saisie';

// minimum length of a password chosen by a patient: same value
// as the server (which also returns {min} with the error PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT)
const MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN = '6';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-inscription',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, ChampsPersonne, ChampSaisie],
  templateUrl: './inscription.html',
})
export default class InscriptionPage {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

  protected readonly modele = signal<Inscription>({ titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', confirmation: '' });
  protected readonly f = form(this.modele);
  protected readonly envoi = new EnvoiFormulaire(this.f);
   // the parameters of the ET help message for password errors
  protected readonly paramsPassword = computed(() => ({ min: MOT_DE_PASSE_MIN, ...this.envoi.params() }));

  protected async creer(evenement: Event): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    let login = '';
    const reussi = await this.envoi.envoyer(async () => {
      login = (await this.api.inscrire(this.modele())).login;
    });
    if (reussi) {
       // return to the login page, login pre-filled
      this.messages.flash('succes', 'INSCRIPTION.DONE', { login });
      this.router.navigate(['/login'], { queryParams: { login } });
    } else if (this.messages.erreur()?.cle === 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT') {
       // Password expired (15 minutes): return to CAPTCHA
      this.messages.flash('erreur', 'ERRORS.CAPTCHA_BEFORE_ACCOUNT');
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }
}

@Component({

  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);

  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly langue = inject(LangueService).langue;

  protected readonly espace = signal<MonEspace | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.charger();

  private async charger(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.espace.set(await this.api.monEspace());
    } catch (e) {

// =========================================================================
// pages/my-account/mon-compte.ts - “Manage My Account” (/my-account, role USER)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Two independent forms, such as views/patient/compte.hbs:
//    1. editing (username, login, optional new password);
//    2. Deleting the account—which also cancels its appointments.
// Both require the password ACTUEL (verified by the server).
// Two forms, therefore two templates, two field trees, and two
// EnvoiFormulaire (two sets of errors).
// =========================================================================

import { Component, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { Router, RouterLink } from '@angular/router';
import { form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { RdvMedecinsApi } from '../../api/rdvmedecins.api';
import { ModificationMonCompte } from '../../api/types';
import { SessionService } from '../../services/session.service';
import { MessagesService } from '../../services/messages.service';
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../services/confirmation.service';
import { EnvoiFormulaire } from '../../services/envoi-formulaire';
import { ChampsPersonne } from '../../components/champs-personne';
import { ChampSaisie } from '../../components/champ-saisie';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-mon-compte',
  imports: [RouterLink, FormField, TranslatePipe, ChampsPersonne, ChampSaisie],
  templateUrl: './mon-compte.html',
})
export default class MonComptePage {
  private readonly api = inject(RdvMedecinsApi);
  private readonly session = inject(SessionService);
  private readonly messages = inject(MessagesService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);

   // 1. Modification
  protected readonly modele = signal<ModificationMonCompte>({
    titre: 'Mr',
    prenom: '',
    nom: '',
    login: '',
    password: '',
    confirmation: '',
    motDePasseActuel: '',
    version: 0,
  });
  protected readonly f = form(this.modele);
  protected readonly modification = new EnvoiFormulaire(this.f);

   // 2. Deletion: a form with a single field
  protected readonly modeleSuppression = signal({ motDePasseActuel: '' });
  protected readonly fs = form(this.modeleSuppression);
  protected readonly suppression = new EnvoiFormulaire(this.fs);

  constructor() {
    this.charger();
  }

  private async charger(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const compte = await this.api.monCompte();
      this.modele.update((m) => ({ ...m, ...compte }));
    } catch (e) {
      this.messages.afficherErreurApi(e);
    }
  }

  protected async enregistrer(evenement: Event): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    const reussi = await this.modification.envoyer(async () => {
       // The server issued a NOUVEAU token (name, login): the
       // navigation bar must follow
      this.session.mettreAJour(await this.api.modifierMonCompte(this.modele()));
      this.messages.flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.UPDATED');
    });
    if (reussi) {
      this.router.navigate(['/mon-espace']);
    } else {
       // never leave a password in the field after a submission is rejected;
       // modify the field itself (not the template) to avoid deleting
       // the errors the server has just attached to it... except for its own
      this.f.motDePasseActuel().value.set('');
    }
  }

  protected async supprimer(evenement: Event): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirmer('MON_COMPTE.DELETE_CONFIRM'))) {
      return;
    }
    const reussi = await this.suppression.envoyer(() => this.api.supprimerMonCompte(this.modeleSuppression().motDePasseActuel));
    if (reussi) {
      this.session.oublier(); // the server has deleted the token cookie
      this.messages.flash('succes', 'MON_COMPTE.DELETED');
      this.router.navigate(['/login']);
    }
  }
}

Two independent forms: account modification and account deletion. Both require the current password, which is verified by the server. Two forms, therefore two templates, two field trees, and two [EnvoiFormulaire]: errors in one do not appear in the other.

  • Lines 60–67: The account is read, and its values are copied into the template (including the version);
  • line 74: After a change, the server returns the updated user (and has issued a new token): the navigation bar must update accordingly;
  • Line 83: After a failed login attempt, the current password is cleared. We update the field (not the entire form): only the error for that field disappears; the others remain displayed;
  • lines 87–98: account deletion, after confirmation. The server has deleted the token cookie: the user is forgotten, and the page returns to the login page.
<div class="row justify-content-center">
  <div class="col-md-8 col-lg-6">
     <!-- 1. modification -->
    <div class="card p-4 mb-4">
      <h5 class="card-title mb-3">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
      <form novalidate (submit)="enregistrer($event)">
        <app-champs-personne [titre]="f.titre" [prenom]="f.prenom" [nom]="f.nom" />

        <h6 class="mt-4 text-muted">{{ 'PERSONNES.ACCOUNT_SECTION' | translate }}</h6>
        <app-champ-saisie class="mb-3" idChamp="login" libelle="PERSONNES.LOGIN_LABEL" [longueurMax]="30" autocomplete="username"
                          requis [formField]="f.login" />
        <div class="row g-3 mb-3">
          <app-champ-saisie class="col-sm-6" idChamp="password" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.NEW_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                            [longueurMax]="72" autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.password"
                            [params]="modification.params()" aide="PERSONNES.PASSWORD_HELP_EDIT" />
          <app-champ-saisie class="col-sm-6" idChamp="confirmation" type="password" libelle="COMPTE.CONFIRMATION_LABEL"
                            [longueurMax]="72" autocomplete="new-password" [formField]="f.confirmation" />
        </div>
        <app-champ-saisie class="mb-4" idChamp="motDePasseActuel" type="password" libelle="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_LABEL"
                          [longueurMax]="72" autocomplete="current-password" requis [formField]="f.motDePasseActuel"
                          aide="MON_COMPTE.CURRENT_PASSWORD_HELP" />
        <div class="d-flex gap-2">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary" [disabled]="f().submitting()">{{ 'PERSONNES.SAVE' | translate }}</button>
          <a class="btn btn-secondary" routerLink="/mon-espace">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.BACK' | translate }}</a>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>

     <!-- 2. deletion -->

      <h5 class="card-title text-danger mb-1">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_TITLE' | translate }}</h5>
      <p class="text-muted small">{{ 'MON_COMPTE.DELETE_HELP' | translate }}</p>

docs.title: 8. Communicating with the server
docs.text: The examples in this chapter query the server JSON [RdvMedecins]: It must be running ([npm run start:dev] in the [rdvmedecins-nestjs-json] folder) on port 8080, at the same time as the [Angular] development server on port 4200.

docs.title: 8.1. Example 22: An initial request for HTTP
8.1.1. The development server’s proxy
docs.text:
The example page comes from http://localhost:4200 (the [Angular] development server, launched by [ng serve]); API is at http://localhost:8080. For a browser, these are two different origins (the port is part of the origin). However, for security reasons, a browser does not allow a page to read responses from another origin unless the server explicitly permits it (the mechanism known as CORS). And a request to another origin does not carry cookies (and therefore not the token), unless the code requests it ([withCredentials: true]) ET and the server accepts it, again via CORS.

Rather than opening the server to other origins, we route requests from API through the development server at [Angular]. This is the proxy declared in the workspace file [proxy.conf.json]:

{
  "/api": {
    "target": "http://localhost:8080",
    "secure": false
  }
}
  • Line 2: Requests whose path begins with /api...
  • line 3: ... are forwarded to the JSON server.

For each example, the file is specified in the options of the [ng serve] command in the [angular.json] file:

"serve": {
  "builder": "@angular/build:dev-server",
  "options": {
    "proxyConfig": "proxy.conf.json"
  },

The browser sends [GET http://localhost:4200/api/captcha]; the development server forwards the request to [http://localhost:8080/api/captcha], then returns the response to the browser. For the browser, the page and API have the same origin:

In production, there will no longer be a development server: the JSON server itself will serve the compiled client files (see the “Deployment” chapter). The page and API will still share the same origin.

docs.title: 8.1.2. The request
docs.text:
[Angular] provides its own client, HTTP, and the service [HttpClient]. It is automatically available in any application: simply inject it.

// =========================================================================
// 22-httpclient/src/app/app.ts - a first request HTTP to the server
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The server JSON RdvMedecins must be running (port 8080). It is asked to
// a CAPTCHA: GET /api/captcha -> { "id": "...", "svg": "<svg ...>" }.
//
//    - HttpClient: the Angular client (provided by default to every
//      application). http.get<T>(url) returns a OBSERVABLE (see example
//      19): the request is not sent until you subscribe to it (ABONNE);
//      the response JSON arrives already converted into an object of the specified type T;
//    - The address is RELATIVE (/api/captcha): the request is sent to the
//      page’s server, the Angular server (port 4200), which forwards it to the
//      JSON server (port 8080) via its proxy (see proxy.conf.json);
//    - three statuses to display: in progress, successful, error.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { DomSanitizer, SafeHtml } from '@angular/platform-browser';

// what GET returns from /api/captcha
interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  templateUrl: './app.html',
  styles: `
    .captcha {
      display: inline-block;
      border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
      border-radius: 0.375rem;
    }
  `,
})
export class App {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);

  protected readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly enCours = signal(false);
  protected readonly erreur = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly nbRequetes = signal(0);

   // [innerHTML] inserts a string like HTML. For security reasons, Angular
   // NETTOIE this HTML ("sanitization"): it removes the scripts... and the
   // <svg> tags. bypassSecurityTrustHtml tells Angular: “This HTML is
   // safe, don’t sanitize it.” Use QUE only for safe content: this SVG
   // is generated by the NOTRE server. With user input, this would
   // open the door to script injection ({{ }} escapes everything).
  protected readonly svg = computed<SafeHtml | null>(() => {
    const c = this.captcha();
    return c ? this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(c.svg) : null;
  });

  constructor() {
    this.charger(); // Upon startup, a CAPTCHA is loaded
  }

  protected charger(): void {
    this.enCours.set(true);
    this.erreur.set(null);
    this.http.get<Captcha>('/api/captcha').subscribe({
       // Next: the response (2xx code), already converted by JSON
      next: (captcha) => {
        this.captcha.set(captcha);
        this.nbRequetes.update((n) => n + 1);
        this.enCours.set(false);
      },
       // error: a 4xx/5xx response, or no response at all (status 0)
      error: (e: HttpErrorResponse) => {
        this.erreur.set(`le serveur a répondu ${e.status} ${e.statusText}`);
        this.captcha.set(null);
        this.enCours.set(false);
      },
    });
  }
}
  • line 22: the format of the response from [GET /api/captcha];
  • line 39: inject the client HTTP;
  • lines 42–45: the three states of a request: in progress, successful (the CAPTCHA), and error;
  • line 65: [http.get<Captcha>(url)] prepares a request GET. It returns an observable (example 19): the request is sent only when subscribed to ([subscribe]). The address is relative: the request is sent to the page’s server, which forwards it to the JSON server;
  • lines 67–71: [next] receives the response, which has already been converted from JSON. [<Captcha>] informs [TypeScript] of the object’s format: the compiler cannot verify what the server will send;
  • Lines 73–77: [error] receives a [HttpErrorResponse] for any 4xx or 5xx response, as well as when no response is received (server down, network disconnected: [status] is then 0). If the JSON server is down, the proxy responds with a 5xx error;
  • line 59: upon startup, a CAPTCHA is loaded;
  • lines 53–56: the SVG image from the CAPTCHA is a string of characters, which must be inserted as HTML ([[innerHTML]] in the template). For security reasons, [Angular] cleans up any HTML inserted in this way: it removes the scripts... and the [<svg>] tags. [bypassSecurityTrustHtml] indicates that this HTML is safe. We only use QUE for safe content: this SVG is generated by the NOTRE server. With user-entered data, this would allow scripts to be injected into the page; the double curly braces [{{ }}], on the other hand, bypass everything.
<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Exemple 22 - une première requête HTTP</h1>
  <div class="card p-3">
    @if (enCours()) {
      <p class="text-muted">Chargement...</p>
    } @else if (erreur()) {
      <div class="alert alert-danger mb-3">
        Impossible d'obtenir un captcha : {{ erreur() }}.<br>
        Le serveur JSON RdvMedecins est-il lancé (port 8080) ?
      </div>
    } @else if (captcha(); as c) {
      <div class="mb-2"><div class="captcha" [innerHTML]="svg()"></div></div>
      <p class="small text-muted">id : <code>{{ c.id }}</code></p>
    }
    <button class="btn btn-primary align-self-start" [disabled]="enCours()" (click)="charger()">Autre image</button>
    <p class="small text-muted mt-2 mb-0">{{ nbRequetes() }} requête(s) réussie(s) - ouvrez l'onglet Réseau des outils de développement (F12).</p>
  </div>
</div>
  • lines 4–14: a status display;
  • line 12: the CAPTCHA image.

[npm start 22-httpclient]; click on [Autre image]:

In the browser's developer tools (F12), the Network tab shows the request [captcha], sent to [localhost:4200], and its response JSON.

docs.title: 8.2. Example 23: Login, Cookie, and Session
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 23-connection/src/app/app.ts - connect to the server RdvMedecins
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
//    1. On startup: GET /api/auth/moi - are we already logged in?
//       (after a F5, the client has forgotten everything; the server, however, reads the cookie);
//    2. Login: POST /api/auth/login, body JSON { login, password,
//       captchaId, captcha }. If successful, the server sets the cookie
//       httpOnly for the token JWT: our code does not see it JAMAIS (try
//       document.cookie in the console: it’s not there);
//    3. Protected request: GET /api/medecins. The browser includes the cookie in this request
//       on its own (same origin);
//    4. Logout: POST /api/auth/logout—the server deletes the cookie.
//
// firstValueFrom (observable): a PROMESSE derived from the first value in the stream.
// We can then write the request sequences using async/await,
// which are more readable than a cascade of `subscribe` calls. An error response rejects
// the promise with a HttpErrorResponse: a simple try/catch.
//
// A cookie is associated with a machine (localhost) and a path (/api): it
// is therefore common to TOUS the examples. Once logged in here, the examples
// 24 and 25 are as well.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';
import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

interface Utilisateur {
  login: string;
  nom: string;
  role: 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';
}
interface Medecin {
  id: number;
  titre: string;
  prenom: string;
  nom: string;
}
interface Captcha {
  id: string;
  svg: string;
}
// the format of TOUTES the error messages in API
interface ErreurApi {
  statusCode: number;
  cle: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
}

// the few messages this example needs (example 25 will use ngx-translate)
const MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  'LOGIN.ERROR': 'Login ou mot de passe incorrect.',
  'ERRORS.WRONG_CAPTCHA': "Les caractères recopiés ne correspondent pas à l'image.",
  'ERRORS.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS': 'Trop de tentatives infructueuses. Réessayez plus tard.',
};

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);

  protected readonly utilisateur = signal<Utilisateur | null>(null);
  protected readonly medecins = signal<Medecin[]>([]);
  protected readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly svg = computed(() => this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(this.captcha()?.svg ?? ''));
  protected readonly login = signal('admin');
  protected readonly password = signal('');
  protected readonly reponseCaptcha = signal('');
  protected readonly erreur = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly pret = signal(false); // Is the initial verification complete?

  constructor() {
    this.verifierSession().catch(() => {
      this.erreur.set('Le serveur JSON RdvMedecins est-il lancé (port 8080) ?');
      this.pret.set(true);
    });
  }

  protected async chargerCaptcha(): Promise<void> {
    this.captcha.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Captcha>('/api/captcha')));
    this.reponseCaptcha.set('');
  }

   // 1. Who is logged in? 200 -> the user; 401 -> no one
  private async verifierSession(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.utilisateur.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Utilisateur>('/api/auth/moi')));
      await this.chargerMedecins();
    } catch (e) {
      if (!(e instanceof HttpErrorResponse) || e.status !== 401) {
        throw e; // Not a 401: the server is not responding
      }
      await this.chargerCaptcha();
    }
    this.pret.set(true);
  }

   // 2. The connection; POST(URL, body): the body is sent in JSON
  protected async seConnecter(): Promise<void> {
    this.erreur.set(null);
    try {
      const u = await firstValueFrom(
        this.http.post<Utilisateur>('/api/auth/login', {
          login: this.login(),
          password: this.password(),
          captchaId: this.captcha()?.id,
          captcha: this.reponseCaptcha(),
        }),
      );
      this.utilisateur.set(u);
      this.password.set('');
      await this.chargerMedecins();
    } catch (e) {
       // e.error: the body JSON of the error response
      const erreurApi = (e as HttpErrorResponse).error as ErreurApi | null;
      const cle = erreurApi?.cle ?? 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE';
      this.erreur.set(`${(e as HttpErrorResponse).status} - ${MESSAGES[cle] ?? cle}`);
      await this.chargerCaptcha(); // Each image is served only once
    }
  }

   // 3. A protected request
  private async chargerMedecins(): Promise<void> {
    this.medecins.set(await firstValueFrom(this.http.get<Medecin[]>('/api/medecins')));
  }

   // 4. Logout
  protected async seDeconnecter(): Promise<void> {
    await firstValueFrom(this.http.post('/api/auth/logout', {}));
    this.utilisateur.set(null);
    this.medecins.set([]);
    await this.chargerCaptcha();
  }
}
  • lines 30–50: the formats of the data exchanged with the server, including those for all errors in API (lines 46–50);
  • lines 53–57: the few messages required by this example, in French; Example 25 will use [ngx-translate];
  • line 28: [firstValueFrom(observable)] returns a promise for the first value in the stream. A HTTP request produces only one value—the response: we can then write request chains using [async] / [await], which are more readable than a cascade of [subscribe]. An error response rejects the promise: a simple [try / catch] catches it;
  • lines 91–102: on startup, [GET /api/auth/moi]: are we already logged in? After reloading the page (F5), the application [Angular] has forgotten everything; the server, however, reads the cookie. 200: the user; 401: no one—in which case, the login form and its CAPTCHA are displayed (line 99);
  • line 96: any other error means the server isn’t responding; it’s reported to the developer (lines 79–82);
  • lines 105–126: the login:
    • line 109: [http.post(url, corps)]: the object [corps] is sent as JSON, with the header [Content-Type: application/json];
    • line 116: if successful, the server has set the token cookie. Our code does not see it (JAMAIS): type [document.cookie] into the browser console; it is not there ([HttpOnly]);
    • line 121: if the request fails, [error] contains the response body JSON, which explains why. We display the message (line 123) and request a new image (line 124): each is used only once;
  • lines 129–131: a protected request. No action is required to authenticate: the browser automatically includes the cookie because the request is going to the same origin as the page;
  • lines 134–139: logout—the server deletes the cookie. The body [{}] is included so that the request is a POST JSON.

A cookie belongs to a machine (localhost) and a path (/api); it is therefore shared by TOUS and the examples. Once logged in here, examples 24 and 25 are also logged in.

The login form:

<div class="container py-4" style="max-width: 640px">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Exemple 23 - connexion au serveur</h1>
  @if (!pret()) {
    <p class="text-muted">Vérification de la session...</p>
  } @else if (utilisateur(); as u) {
     <!-- Logged in -->
    <div class="card p-3">
      <p>Connecté : <strong>{{ u.nom }}</strong> ({{ u.login }}), rôle <span class="badge text-bg-primary">{{ u.role }}</span></p>
      <h2 class="h6">GET /api/medecins</h2>
      <ul>
        @for (m of medecins(); track m.id) {
          <li>{{ m.titre }} {{ m.prenom }} {{ m.nom }}</li>
        }
      </ul>
      <p class="small text-muted">Rechargez la page (F5) : vous restez connecté.</p>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-secondary align-self-start" (click)="seDeconnecter()">Se déconnecter</button>
    </div>
  } @else {
     <!-- not logged in: the form -->
    <form class="card p-3" (ngSubmit)="seConnecter()">
      <div class="mb-2">
        <label class="form-label" for="login">Login</label>
        <input id="login" name="login" class="form-control" autocomplete="username" [(ngModel)]="login">
      </div>
      <div class="mb-2">
        <label class="form-label" for="password">Mot de passe</label>
        <input id="password" name="password" type="password" class="form-control" autocomplete="current-password"
               [(ngModel)]="password">
      </div>
      <div class="mb-3">
        <label class="form-label" for="captcha">Recopiez les caractères de l'image</label>
        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          <div [innerHTML]="svg()"></div>
          <a href="#" class="small" (click)="$event.preventDefault(); chargerCaptcha()">Autre image</a>
        </div>
        <input id="captcha" name="captcha" class="form-control" autocomplete="off" [(ngModel)]="reponseCaptcha">
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary">Se connecter</button>
      <p class="small text-muted mt-2 mb-0">Comptes : admin, pelissier, martin... (mot de passe = login).</p>
    </form>
  }
  @if (erreur()) {
    <div class="alert alert-danger mt-3">{{ erreur() }}</div>
  }
</div>
  • Line 3: Until the initial verification is complete, we don’t know what to display;
  • lines 5–17: logged in: the user and the list of doctors;
  • lines 20–40: not logged in: the form, with [ngModel] (example 05);
  • line 34: [$event.preventDefault()] prevents the link from following its address (#).

[npm start 23-connexion]. With an incorrect password (the server is in test mode: any CAPTCHA accepts the response [test]):

With the correct password, followed by a page refresh (F5): you remain logged in.

docs.title: 8.3. Example 24: An access layer for API
docs.text:
In Example 23, each request repeated the same steps: the /api prefix, [firstValueFrom], reading the error body, and selecting a message. This example groups them into a few files, located in the [commun] folder of the workspace, because Example 25 also uses them:

exemples-angular/commun/
├── types.ts                les objets JSON de l'API
├── erreur-api.ts           une classe pour toutes les erreurs de l'API
├── erreurs.interceptor.ts  un intercepteur HTTP
├── api.service.ts          des requêtes en une ligne
└── barre-connexion.ts      la connexion, en une barre

The [tsconfig.app.json] file in the example adds this folder to the files to be compiled:

{
  "extends": "../tsconfig.json",
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "../commun/**/*.ts"]
}

docs.text:
The types of the JSON objects in API, described in the previous chapter:

// =========================================================================
// shared/types.ts - the JSON objects exchanged with the API RdvMedecins
// (see the chapter on the black box, which describes each route)

export type Role = 'ADMIN' | 'DOCTOR' | 'USER';

}

docs.title: 8.3.2. Errors
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// common/erreur-api.ts - UNE class for all errors from API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// All error responses from the RdvMedecins server have the same format:
//    { "statusCode": 409, "cle": "ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN", "params": {...}, "fields": {...} }
// HttpClient indicates this with a HttpErrorResponse, whose "error" property
// contains this body JSON... or something else: null (no response), text
// (a proxy error page when the server JSON is down). We
// converts all of this into the UNE class, ErreurApi, which carries the
// translation key sent by the server (and, if any, its parameters and
// error for each field).
// =========================================================================

import { HttpErrorResponse } from '@angular/common/http';

export class ErreurApi extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly statusCode: number, // 0: the server did not respond
    public readonly cle: string, // e.g., 'ERRORS.LOGIN_TAKEN'
    public readonly params: Record<string, string> = {},
    public readonly champs: Record<string, string> = {},
  ) {
    super(cle);
    this.name = 'ErreurApi';
  }
}

// any error -> a ErreurApi
export function versErreurApi(e: unknown): ErreurApi {
  if (e instanceof ErreurApi) {
    return e;
  }
  if (!(e instanceof HttpErrorResponse)) {
    return new ErreurApi(0, 'ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR');
  }
   // the body of the error (JSON), if it exists and is in the correct format
  const corps = (typeof e.error === 'object' && e.error !== null ? e.error : {}) as {
    cle?: string;
    params?: Record<string, string>;
    champs?: Record<string, string>;
  };
   // no key: the response did not come from our server (proxy, network)
  const cle = corps.cle ?? (e.status === 0 || e.status >= 500 ? 'ERRORS.SERVER_UNREACHABLE' : 'ERRORS.SERVER_ERROR');
  return new ErreurApi(e.status, cle, corps.params, corps.champs);
}
  • Lines 16–26: an error class containing the server’s response: the code HTTP, the message key, its parameters, and the error for each field. The code 0 means “no response”;
  • lines 29–45: the conversion of any error to [ErreurApi]:
    • line 37: the body of the response is used only if it is an object. When the JSON server is down, the proxy responds with text;
    • line 43: without a key, it was not our server that responded.

docs.title: 8.3.3. An Interceptor
docs.text:
An interceptor is a function through which requests from [HttpClient] and their responses pass. It can modify the request before it is sent (add a header, for example) or the response upon its return.

// =========================================================================
// common/erreurs.interceptor.ts - a INTERCEPTEUR HTTP
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// An interceptor is a function through which requests pass
// from HttpClient (and their responses). It receives the request (req) and the next segment
// in the chain (next):
//    - next(req) sends the request and returns the observable for the response;
//    - the request can be modified beforehand (req.clone({...})), or the response
//      afterward (using RxJS operators on the observable).
// This converts any error to ErreurApi (catchError): the rest of
// the application never has to deal with HttpErrorResponse again.
// It is declared in the application configuration:
//      provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([erreursInterceptor]))
// =========================================================================

import { HttpInterceptorFn } from '@angular/common/http';
import { catchError, throwError } from 'rxjs';
import { versErreurApi } from './erreur-api';

export const erreursInterceptor: HttpInterceptorFn = (req, next) =>
  next(req).pipe(catchError((e: unknown) => throwError(() => versErreurApi(e))));
  • Line 20: An interceptor receives the request ([req]) and the rest of the string ([next]). [next(req)] sends the request and returns the observable for the response;
  • Line 21: The [catchError] operator replaces any errors in the stream with a [ErreurApi]. The rest of the application never has to deal with [HttpErrorResponse] again.

docs.title: 8.3.4. The ApiService service
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// common/api.service.ts - requests to API, in a single line
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// In Example 23, each request repeated the same steps: prefix
// /api, firstValueFrom, reading the error body... We’ve grouped them here:
//
//    const doctors = await this.api.get<Person[]>('/doctors');
//    await this.api.post('/appointments', { day, idCreneau, idClient });
//
//    - if successful, the promise returns the body JSON, TYPÉ;
//    - if it fails, it is REJETÉE with a ErreurApi (thanks to
//      the interceptor erreurs.interceptor.ts).
// Used in Examples 24 and 25; the case study follows the same principle.
// =========================================================================

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ApiService {
  private readonly http = inject(HttpClient);

  get<T>(url: string): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.get<T>(`/api${url}`));
  }

   // A POST always has a JSON body (the server rejects a POST that does not have one)
  post<T>(url: string, corps: unknown = {}): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.post<T>(`/api${url}`, corps));
  }

  put<T>(url: string, corps: unknown): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.put<T>(`/api${url}`, corps));
  }

  delete<T>(url: string, corps?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    return firstValueFrom(this.http.delete<T>(`/api${url}`, { body: corps }));
  }
}
  • lines 24–39: a method for each HTTP verb. Each adds the prefix /api and returns a promise for the response body, typed as: [api.get<Personne[]>('/medecins')] returns a [Promise<Personne[]>]. In case of failure, the promise is rejected with a [ErreurApi];
  • Line 29: [post] sends the body [{}] by default: the server rejects a POST that is not in JSON.

docs.title: 8.3.5. The API access layer
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 24-service-api/src/app/rdvmedecins.service.ts - the access layer to the API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A typed method per route of the API. The components are unaware of either
// the URL, HttpClient, or the JSON format: they call methods.
// This is the client-side equivalent of the server-side DAO layer: if the API
// changes (a URL, a field name), only this file is modified.
// =========================================================================

import { inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpResourceRequest } from '@angular/common/http';
import { ApiService } from '../../../commun/api.service';
import { Personne } from '../../../commun/types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RdvMedecinsService {
  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);

  getMedecins(): Promise<Personne[]> {
    return this.api.get<Personne[]>('/medecins');
  }

  getClients(): Promise<Personne[]> {
    return this.api.get<Personne[]>('/clients');
  }

   // the DESCRIPTION from the calendar request, for httpResource (see app.ts);
   // generates the parameters "?idMedecin=1&jour=2030-01-15", encoding the necessary information
  requeteAgenda(idMedecin: number, jour: string): HttpResourceRequest {
    return { url: '/api/agenda', params: { idMedecin, jour } };
  }

  reserver(jour: string, idCreneau: number, idClient?: number): Promise<{ id: number }> {
    return this.api.post<{ id: number }>('/rendez-vous', { jour, idCreneau, idClient });
  }

  annuler(idRv: number): Promise<Record<string, never>> {
    return this.api.delete<Record<string, never>>(`/rendez-vous/${idRv}`);
  }
}

A method per route of the API. The components no longer know the addresses, the [HttpClient], or the JSON format: they call methods. This is the client-side equivalent of the server-side data access layer: if API changes, only this file needs to be modified.

  • Lines 29–31: the description of the calendar request, not the request itself: it will be used by [httpResource] (see below). [params] generates the string [?idMedecin=1&jour=2030-01-15] by encoding the characters that need to be encoded.

docs.title: 8.3.6. The login bar
docs.text:
The form from Example 23, reduced to a bar and rewritten using [ApiService]:

// =========================================================================
// common/barre-connexion.ts - log in / log out, as a single bar
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The form from Example 23, reduced to a single bar and rewritten as
// ApiService. The component sends utilisateurChange with the user
// logged in (or null) whenever the user changes—including at
// startup, after querying GET /api/auth/me.
//
// ViewEncapsulation.None: the component’s styles are applied to TOUTE the
// page. Note: the captcha's <svg> element, inserted by [innerHTML], does not
// does not have the attributes required by Angular’s “encapsulated” style.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, output, signal, ViewEncapsulation } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { DomSanitizer } from '@angular/platform-browser';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { ErreurApi } from './erreur-api';
import { Captcha, Utilisateur } from './types';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-barre-connexion',
  imports: [FormsModule],
  encapsulation: ViewEncapsulation.None,
  styles: `
    .barre-captcha svg {
      display: block;
      height: 32px;
      width: auto;
    }
  `,
  template: `
    <div class="alert alert-secondary d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 py-2">
      @if (utilisateur(); as u) {
        <span>Connecté : <strong>{{ u.nom }}</strong> <span class="badge text-bg-primary ms-1">{{ u.role }}</span></span>
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary ms-auto" (click)="seDeconnecter()">Se déconnecter</button>
      } @else {
        <form class="d-flex flex-wrap align-items-center gap-2 w-100" (ngSubmit)="seConnecter()">
          <input name="login" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="login" autocomplete="username"
                 [(ngModel)]="login">
          <input name="password" type="password" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="mot de passe"
                 autocomplete="current-password" [(ngModel)]="password">
          <div class="barre-captcha" [innerHTML]="svg()"></div>
          <input name="captcha" class="form-control form-control-sm w-auto" placeholder="captcha" autocomplete="off" size="8"
                 [(ngModel)]="reponseCaptcha">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary">Se connecter</button>
          @if (erreur()) {
            <span class="text-danger small">{{ erreur() }}</span>
          }
        </form>
      }
    </div>
  `,
})
export class BarreConnexion {
  readonly utilisateurChange = output<Utilisateur | null>();

  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);
  protected readonly utilisateur = signal<Utilisateur | null>(null);
  private readonly captcha = signal<Captcha | null>(null);
  protected readonly svg = computed(() => this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustHtml(this.captcha()?.svg ?? ''));
  protected readonly login = signal('admin');
  protected readonly password = signal('');
  protected readonly reponseCaptcha = signal('');
  protected readonly erreur = signal<string | null>(null);

  constructor() {
    this.demarrer();
  }

  private async demarrer(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.changer(await this.api.get<Utilisateur>('/auth/moi'));
    } catch {
      this.changer(null); // 401: No one is logged in
      await this.nouveauCaptcha().catch(() => this.erreur.set('Le serveur JSON est-il lancé (port 8080) ?'));
    }
  }

  private async nouveauCaptcha(): Promise<void> {
    this.captcha.set(await this.api.get<Captcha>('/captcha'));
    this.reponseCaptcha.set('');
  }

  private changer(u: Utilisateur | null): void {
    this.utilisateur.set(u);
    this.utilisateurChange.emit(u);
  }

  protected async seConnecter(): Promise<void> {
    this.erreur.set(null);
    try {
      const u = await this.api.post<Utilisateur>('/auth/login', {
        login: this.login(),
        password: this.password(),
        captchaId: this.captcha()?.id,
        captcha: this.reponseCaptcha(),
      });
      this.password.set('');
      this.changer(u);
    } catch (e) {
      this.erreur.set(e instanceof ErreurApi ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.cle}` : String(e));
      await this.nouveauCaptcha();
    }
  }

  protected async seDeconnecter(): Promise<void> {
    await this.api.post('/auth/logout');
    this.changer(null);
    await this.nouveauCaptcha();
  }
}
  • line 56: the component sends [utilisateurChange] with the logged-in user (or [null]) every time it changes, including at startup;
  • line 74: with [ApiService], a request fits on a single line; in case of failure (401), it transitions to [catch];
  • line 103: [instanceof] distinguishes an error in API from another anomaly;
  • line 24: [ViewEncapsulation.None]: the component’s styles apply to the entire page. By default, [Angular] limits a component’s styles to its template by adding specific attributes to its elements. The [<svg>] inserted by [[innerHTML]] does not have these attributes: without this option, the rule in lines 26–30 would not apply to it.

docs.title: 8.3.8. The page
docs.text:
// =========================================================================
// 24-service-api/src/app/app.ts—a calendar, with the access layer to the API
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Log in (top bar), choose a doctor and a day: the calendar
// is displayed. ADMIN and DOCTOR can make appointments for a patient and cancel them;
// a patient (Martin...) makes an appointment for themselves. Each action ends with
// a refresh of the calendar: SERVEUR is the definitive version.
//
// httpResource: a GET request described by a function that reads
// signals (here, idMedecin and “day”). Angular sends it initially, then the
// RENVOIE every time one of these signals changes. The result is a
// signal object: value() (the response), isLoading(), error()... and
// reload() to send it back to the request.
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, effect, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { httpResource } from '@angular/common/http';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { BarreConnexion } from '../../../commun/barre-connexion';
import { ErreurApi } from '../../../commun/erreur-api';
import { Agenda, CreneauAgenda, Personne, Utilisateur } from '../../../commun/types';
import { RdvMedecinsService } from './rdvmedecins.service';

function demain(): string {
  const d = new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormsModule, BarreConnexion],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly rdv = inject(RdvMedecinsService);

  protected readonly utilisateur = signal<Utilisateur | null>(null);
  protected readonly medecins = signal<Personne[]>([]);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Personne[]>([]);
  protected readonly idMedecin = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly jour = signal(demain());
  protected readonly idClient = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly message = signal<{ type: 'success' | 'danger'; texte: string } | null>(null);

  protected readonly gestionnaire = computed(() => this.utilisateur() !== null && this.utilisateur()?.role !== 'USER');

   // undefined: no request (no doctor selected, or no one logged in)
  protected readonly agenda = httpResource<Agenda>(() => {
    const id = this.idMedecin();
    return id === null || this.utilisateur() === null ? undefined : this.rdv.requeteAgenda(id, this.jour());
  });

   // the error from the last calendar request, in the form of ErreurApi
  protected readonly erreurAgenda = computed(() => {
    const e = this.agenda.error();
    return e instanceof ErreurApi ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.cle}` : null;
  });

  constructor() {
     // Selecting a new doctor or day clears the previous message
    effect(() => {
      this.idMedecin();
      this.jour();
      this.message.set(null);
    });
  }

  protected horaire(c: CreneauAgenda): string {
    const hm = (h: number, m: number) => `${h}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    return `${hm(c.hdebut, c.mdebut)} - ${hm(c.hfin, c.mfin)}`;
  }

   // an error in API becomes a message (its key, for lack of a dictionary here)
  private signaler(e: unknown): void {
    this.message.set({ type: 'danger', texte: e instanceof ErreurApi ? `${e.statusCode} ${e.cle}` : String(e) });
  }

   // Login/logout: (re)load what this role is authorized to view
  protected async surConnexion(u: Utilisateur | null): Promise<void> {
    this.utilisateur.set(u);
    this.medecins.set([]);
    this.clients.set([]);
    if (u === null) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      this.medecins.set(await this.rdv.getMedecins());
       // the patient list: only for ADMIN and DOCTOR (a USER would receive a 403)
      this.clients.set(this.gestionnaire() ? await this.rdv.getClients() : []);
    } catch (e) {
      this.signaler(e);
    }
  }

  protected async reserver(c: CreneauAgenda): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.rdv.reserver(this.jour(), c.id, this.gestionnaire() ? (this.idClient() ?? undefined) : undefined);
      this.message.set({ type: 'success', texte: `Créneau ${this.horaire(c)} réservé.` });
    } catch (e) {
      this.signaler(e);
    }
    this.agenda.reload();
  }

  protected async annuler(c: CreneauAgenda): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.rdv.annuler(c.idRv as number);
      this.message.set({ type: 'success', texte: `Rendez-vous de ${this.horaire(c)} annulé.` });
    } catch (e) {
      this.signaler(e);
    }
    this.agenda.reload();
  }
}
  • line 45: ADMIN or DOCTOR;
  • lines 48–51: [httpResource] describes a GET request via a function that reads signals (here, [idMedecin], [jour], and [utilisateur]). [Angular] initially sends the request, then resends it whenever one of these signals changes. The function returns [undefined] when there is no request to send. The result is a collection of signals: [value()] (the response), [isLoading()], [error()], [hasValue()]... and a method, [reload()], to resend the request on demand. If a request is still in progress when the signals change, it is abandoned, as with [switchMap] (Example 19);
  • lines 54–57: the error in the last calendar request. Requests from [httpResource] also pass through the interceptor: the error is a [ErreurApi];
  • lines 61–65: a function that clears the previous message when the doctor or the day changes;
  • lines 79–93: Each time a user logs in or out, the system (re)loads what that role is authorized to view. A patient would receive a 403 error for the client list: we don’t even request it;
  • lines 95–103: a reservation, followed by QUOI QU'IL ARRIVE, and a reload of the calendar (line 102). The server’s record is final: if the time slot has been taken by someone else in the meantime, the refreshed calendar will show it;
  • line 97: an administrator makes a reservation for the selected patient; a patient makes a reservation for themselves.
<div class="container py-4">
  <h1 class="h3 mb-3">Exemple 24 - une couche d'accès à l'API</h1>
  <app-barre-connexion (utilisateurChange)="surConnexion($event)" />

  @if (utilisateur()) {
    <div class="row g-2 mb-3">
      <div class="col-sm-5">
        <select class="form-select" [(ngModel)]="idMedecin">
          <option [ngValue]="null" disabled>-- choisir un médecin --</option>
          @for (m of medecins(); track m.id) {
            <option [ngValue]="m.id">{{ m.titre }} {{ m.prenom }} {{ m.nom }}</option>
          }
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="col-sm-3"><input type="date" class="form-control" [(ngModel)]="jour"></div>
      @if (gestionnaire()) {
        <div class="col-sm-4">
          <select class="form-select" [(ngModel)]="idClient">
            <option [ngValue]="null">-- patient à inscrire --</option>
            @for (c of clients(); track c.id) {
              <option [ngValue]="c.id">{{ c.titre }} {{ c.prenom }} {{ c.nom }}</option>
            }
          </select>
        </div>
      }
    </div>

    @if (message(); as m) {
      <div class="alert" [class]="'alert-' + m.type">{{ m.texte }}</div>
    }
    @if (erreurAgenda()) {
      <div class="alert alert-danger">{{ erreurAgenda() }}</div>
    }
    @if (agenda.isLoading()) {
      <p class="small text-muted">chargement de l'agenda...</p>
    }

     <!-- hasValue(): a response is available (value() is not undefined) -->
    @if (agenda.hasValue()) {
      @let a = agenda.value();
       <!-- info: the key sent by the server when a patient already has an upcoming appointment -->
      @if (a.info) {
        <div class="alert alert-info">{{ a.info }}</div>
      }
      <table class="table table-sm align-middle">
        <caption class="caption-top">Agenda du {{ a.jour }} - {{ a.medecin.titre }} {{ a.medecin.prenom }} {{ a.medecin.nom }}</caption>
        <tbody>
          @for (c of a.creneaux; track c.id) {
            <tr>
              <td>{{ horaire(c) }}</td>
              <td>
                @if (c.libre) {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-success">Libre</span>
                } @else if (c.patient; as p) {
                  <span class="badge" [class]="c.moi ? 'text-bg-primary' : 'text-bg-secondary'">{{ p.titre }} {{ p.prenom }} {{ p.nom }}</span>
                } @else {
                  <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">Réservé</span>
                }
              </td>
              <td class="text-end">
                 <!-- The buttons reflect the permissions calculated by the server -->
                @if (c.reservable) {
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-success" (click)="reserver(c)">Réserver</button>
                }
                @if (c.idRv !== null) {
                  <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" (click)="annuler(c)">Annuler</button>
                }
              </td>
            </tr>
          }
        </tbody>
      </table>
    }
  }
</div>
  • line 3: the login bar;
  • line 34: [isLoading()]: a request is in progress;
  • line 39: [hasValue()]: a response is available;
  • line 40: [@let] prevents [agenda.value()] from being repeated;
  • line 57: a busy slot for which the server did not send the patient (as seen by a patient);
  • lines 62–67: the buttons follow the permissions calculated by the server.

import { Provider } from '@angular/core';
import { provideTranslateLoader, provideTranslateService, TranslateLoader, TranslationObject } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { Observable, of } from 'rxjs';
import fr from './fr.json';
import en from './en.json';

class DictionnairesLoader implements TranslateLoader {
  getTranslation(langue: string): Observable<TranslationObject> {
    return of(langue === 'en' ? en : fr);
  }
}

export function provideI18n(): Provider[] {
  return provideTranslateService({ loader: provideTranslateLoader(DictionnairesLoader), fallbackLang: 'fr', lang: 'fr' });
}
