The page:

// =========================================================================
// 25-server-errors/src/app/app.ts - display errors from SERVEUR
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Customer management (admin account). This form does not
// VOLONTAIREMENT perform any validation in the browser: its schema is empty.
// Everything is sent to the server, which responds with an error if the request is rejected
// JSON (converted to ErreurApi by the interceptor):
//
//    400 { key: 'ERRORS.INVALID_FORM', fields: { name: 'ERRORS.LASTNAME_REQUIRED' } }
//    409 { key: 'ERRORS.PATIENT_ALREADY_EXISTS', fields: { first_name: ..., last_name: ... } }
//    409 { key: 'ERRORS.CONCURRENT_UPDATE'         } (optimistic lock)
//
// submit(form, action): the action sends the form to the server. If it
// returns ERREURS (an array), the form fields attach them
// to the designated fields (fieldTree): they appear in f.nom().errors(),
// as validator errors. Their message is the CLÉ sent by
// the server, which the template translates (ngx-translate). Try it: an empty name
// empty name, a title like "Dr.", a namesake (Alice DURAND), a username that’s already taken
// (martin), the same record edited in two tabs...
// =========================================================================

import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FormField, form, submit, ValidationError } from '@angular/forms/signals';
import { TranslatePipe, TranslateService } from '@ngx-translate/core';
import { ApiService } from '../../../commun/api.service';
import { BarreConnexion } from '../../../commun/barre-connexion';
import { ErreurApi } from '../../../commun/erreur-api';
import { Personne, Utilisateur } from '../../../commun/types';
// the confirmation window from Example 16, reused as-is
import { ConfirmationService } from '../../../16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/confirmation.service';
import { FenetreConfirmation } from '../../../16-confirmation/src/app/confirmation/fenetre-confirmation';

interface SaisieClient {
  titre: string;
  prenom: string;
  nom: string;
  login: string;
  password: string;
  version: number;
}

const VIDE: SaisieClient = { titre: 'Mr', prenom: '', nom: '', login: '', password: '', version: 0 };

@Component({
  selector: 'app-root',
  imports: [FormField, TranslatePipe, BarreConnexion, FenetreConfirmation],
  templateUrl: './app.html',
})
export class App {
  private readonly api = inject(ApiService);
  private readonly confirmation = inject(ConfirmationService);
  protected readonly translate = inject(TranslateService);

  protected readonly utilisateur = signal<Utilisateur | null>(null);
  protected readonly clients = signal<Personne[]>([]);
  protected readonly estAdmin = computed(() => this.utilisateur()?.role === 'ADMIN');

   // the form: idEdite === null -> create, otherwise update
  protected readonly idEdite = signal<number | null>(null);
  protected readonly modele = signal<SaisieClient>({ ...VIDE });
  protected readonly f = form(this.modele); // no validator: the server handles validation
   // the general message for the last error, and the success message
  protected readonly erreurPage = signal<ErreurApi | null>(null);
  protected readonly succes = signal<{ cle: string; params: Record<string, string> } | null>(null);

  protected async surConnexion(u: Utilisateur | null): Promise<void> {
    this.utilisateur.set(u);
    this.clients.set([]);
    if (u?.role === 'ADMIN') {
      await this.recharger();
    }
  }

  private async recharger(): Promise<void> {
    this.clients.set(await this.api.get<Personne[]>('/clients'));
  }

  protected nouveau(): void {
    this.idEdite.set(null);
    this.modele.set({ ...VIDE });
    this.f().reset(); // the field status (and any errors) resets to zero
    this.effacerMessages();
  }

  protected editer(c: Personne): void {
    this.idEdite.set(c.id);
     // the VERSION file read with the record resumes with the update: if someone
     // has modified the record in the meantime, the server will return a 409 response CONCURRENT_UPDATE
    this.modele.set({ titre: c.titre, prenom: c.prenom, nom: c.nom, login: c.login ?? '', password: '', version: c.version });
    this.f().reset();
    this.effacerMessages();
  }

  private effacerMessages(): void {
    this.erreurPage.set(null);
    this.succes.set(null);
  }

   // Error in the CHAQUE field, returned by the server -> a form error
  private erreursDesChamps(e: ErreurApi): ValidationError.WithOptionalFieldTree[] {
    const champs = Object.keys(this.modele()) as (keyof SaisieClient)[];
    return Object.entries(e.champs)
      .filter(([champ]) => champs.includes(champ as keyof SaisieClient))
      .map(([champ, cle]) => ({ kind: 'serveur', message: cle, fieldTree: this.f[champ as keyof SaisieClient] }));
  }

  protected async enregistrer(evenement: SubmitEvent): Promise<void> {
    evenement.preventDefault();
    this.effacerMessages();
    const id = this.idEdite();
    await submit(this.f, async () => {
      try {
        const corps = this.modele();
        const client =
          id === null
            ? await this.api.post<Personne>('/clients', corps)
            : await this.api.put<Personne>(`/clients/${id}`, corps);
        this.nouveau(); // form cleared, messages deleted...
         // ... except this one
        this.succes.set({
          cle: id === null ? 'FORM.AJOUTE' : 'FORM.MODIFIE',
          params: { nom: `${client.prenom} ${client.nom}`, login: client.login ?? '' },
        });
        await this.recharger();
        return null;
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof ErreurApi)) {
          throw e;
        }
        this.erreurPage.set(e); // the general message
        return this.erreursDesChamps(e); // the error for each field
      }
    });
  }

  protected async supprimer(c: Personne): Promise<void> {
    const nom = `${c.prenom} ${c.nom}`;
    if (!(await this.confirmation.confirmer(this.translate.instant('FORM.CONFIRMER_SUPPRESSION', { nom })))) {
      return;
    }
    this.effacerMessages();
    try {
      await this.api.delete(`/clients/${c.id}`);
      this.succes.set({ cle: 'FORM.SUPPRIME', params: { nom } });
    } catch (e) {
      this.erreurPage.set(e instanceof ErreurApi ? e : null);
    }
    await this.recharger();
  }
}
  • lines 30–31: the confirmation window from Example 16, reused as-is: a well-designed component is reusable;
  • line 61: a form with error indicators (example 06), without a schema: no validator;
  • lines 63–64: the general message for the last error, and the success message;
  • lines 85–92: To edit a record, copy its values into the form, including the version number: the record will be updated with the change (optimistic locking). [reset()] resets the state of the fields and their errors;
  • lines 107–134: saving the record. [submit(formulaire, action)] executes the action, which sends the form to the server: POST for a creation (line 116), PUT for a modification (line 117). During its execution, [f().submitting()] is true;
  • line 125: [null]: no error;
  • lines 130–131: in case of rejection, the general message is retained, and field errors are returned. The form validation system then attaches them to the designated fields: they appear in [f.nom().errors()], exactly like validator errors; they disappear as soon as the user modifies the field;
  • lines 100–105: the conversion. Each error identifies its field ([fieldTree], line 104); its message is the key sent by the server. Line 103 ignores an unknown field in the form;
  • line 138: [translate.instant(clé, paramètres)]: the translation of a key in the code;
  • line 146: the deletion of a customer may also be rejected.
<div class="container py-4">

          <div class="mb-2">

            </select>

            </div>

              <input id="nom" class="form-control" [formField]="f.nom">

            </div>

            <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" (click)="nouveau()">{{ 'FORM.ANNULER' | translate }}</button>
          </div>

          }
